ruleDefinitions.name: Nslookup PowerShell Download Cradle - ProcessCreation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious powershell download cradle using nslookup. This cradle uses nslookup to extract payloads from DNS records

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\nslookup\\\.exe.*") OR process_original_file_name = "\\nslookup\.exe") AND ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-q\\=txt\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-querytype\\=txt\\ .*"))))
